symptoms: swipe navigation moving up and down instead of left and right
articles.referenceContent: When swipe navigation gestures move vertically rather than horizontally, the navigation bar type or gesture hints have been reconfigured. First, open Settings on your device. Next, tap Display. Then, tap Navigation bar. Select Swipe gestures and choose your preferred gesture orientation from More options. Finally, if third-party gesture apps interfere, reboot your phone into Safe Mode to test default behavior.

steps: Press and hold the Power button.

articles.referenceContent: If your phone battery is draining quickly, enable Power Saving Mode to limit background network syncing and CPU frequency. Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, tap Battery, and toggle Power saving. Next, check Background usage limits to put unused apps into deep sleep. If the phone still loses charge rapidly, inspect the physical USB charging port for debris or moisture.

recommendedActions.description: It will reduce background power consumption
It will restrict unused background apps
steps: Enable Put unused apps to sleep.

steps: Inspect the USB port with light.

symptoms: camera is blurry and out of focus
articles.referenceContent: When camera images appear blurry, first wipe the exterior camera lens gently with a microfiber cloth to remove smudges. Next, open the Camera app, tap Settings, and tap Reset settings to restore default autofocus calibration. If camera lag or black screen persists, perform a system restart.

recommendedActions.description: It will remove lens surface smudges
steps: Take a clean dry microfiber cloth.
Ensure no dust or oil remains.

recommendedActions.description: It will restore default camera calibration
steps: Scroll down and tap Reset settings.

symptoms: apps taking long time to open
articles.referenceContent: If the phone experiences lag and UI stuttering, clear background RAM and optimize storage. Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, tap Memory, and tap Clean now to terminate idle background tasks. Next, tap Storage to delete temporary cache files. If performance remains severely degraded, consider a Factory data reset after backing up your data.

recommendedActions.description: It will terminate idle background tasks
steps: Tap Clean now to free RAM.
